beats.event: Yi Mongryong spots Chunhyang on a swing and falls in love at first sight
His servant approaches on his behalf; Chunhyang declines
Her mother Wolmae gives consent to the union
Chunhyang and Mongryong marry that same day
Mongryong must leave for Hanyang with his transferred father
She gives him a ring and vows to remain faithful
Corrupt Byeon Hakdo arrives as the new magistrate
Summoned as though a gisaeng; she protests her status
Refuses Byeon's demands; is beaten and imprisoned
Chunhyang languishes in jail as Byeon's abuses continue
Mongryong wins first place in the state exam, made secret royal inspector
He returns disguised as a beggar to investigate Byeon's rule
He tests her fidelity by proposing she become his gisaeng; she refuses
The ring reveals his true identity to the stunned Chunhyang
Mongryong punishes Byeon and frees Chunhyang
The reunited couple live happily ever after
